title: Echoes of Tomorrow
setting_summary: In the sprawling mega-city of Neo-Akasha, where towering skyscrapers scrape the clouds and a constant drizzle mutes the world below, the residents are bound by invisible chains. The city is controlled by the Syndicate, a shadowy organization that governs every aspect of life through pervasive surveillance and scarcity.
